svg.text: One elliptic curve, its rational points, and the chord rule
E : y² + y = x³ − x, the curve of conductor 37 (Cremona label 37a1). Rank 1, generated by P = (0, 0).
A line through two rational points of E meets
it in a third rational point. Reflecting that point
in the mirror line gives their sum. Here the line
y = x through P and 3P meets E again at (2, 2),
Every rational point of E is nP for a whole number n
(with 0P = O, the point at infinity). So E(ℚ) ≅ ℤ:
The fractions get longer fast: log(size of the
numbers in nP) grows like n² × 0.0511… That rate
is the canonical height of P, and here it is the
The BSD formula for this curve
Torsion, Tamagawa number and Ш are all 1 here.
